## Summary

Forge runs the site on PHP 8.5, and the lock file already resolves packages that need 8.4.1 or newer. `composer.json` now states the version that is actually deployed (`"php": "^8.5"`), so an older server refuses the install up front instead of breaking halfway. The lock file carries the new platform requirement; no package changed. CI tests on 8.5 only.

No code change: the suite was already green on 8.5 (23 tests, 161 assertions) and 8.5 raises no deprecation notices.

## After merge

Nothing on the server.
